# Data Source: identitynow_launcher

Use this data source to look up a launcher by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_launcher" "onboarding" {
  id = "e3012408-8b61-4564-ad41-c5ec131c325b"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Launcher ID.

### Read-Only

- `config_json` (String) Launcher configuration as a JSON object.
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `description` (String) Description of the launcher.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the launcher is disabled.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `name` (String) Name of the launcher.
- `owner` (Attributes List) Owner of the launcher. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `reference` (Attributes List) Object the launcher starts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reference))
- `type` (String) Launcher type.

<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Owner ID.
- `type` (String) Owner type.


<a id="nestedatt--reference"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reference`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) ID of the referenced object.
- `type` (String) Type of the referenced object.
